name: Tea Sieve and Tea Sieve Rack

pages.title: Tea Sieve
pages.text: The Tea Sieve is both an item and a block: 1 sieve equals 1 block.$(br2)It is the working part of the Tea Sieve Rack. Craft the sieve and the rack first, then insert the sieve into the rack.

pages.title: Tea Sieve Rack
pages.text: The Tea Sieve Rack can hold up to 3 Tea Sieves, and each slot works independently.$(br2)Drying one batch in a slot takes 400 ticks (20 seconds).

pages.title: Drying Tea
pages.text: Put fixed and rolled tea leaves onto the Tea Sieve Rack to dry them into the matching finished tea.
